description: Audit a website's /llms.txt file against the published standard. Returns a 0-100 score, grade, presence of required structural elements (H1, blockquote, sections), link health, and freshness. Use this when you want to know if a site is properly exposing its content map to AI engines that respect llms.txt (Anthropic Claude, with OpenAI and others stated to follow). More at neverranked.com.

url.description: Base URL of the site to check. The tool fetches /llms.txt at the root of this URL.

name: llms_txt_check
